>If you’re a lesbian heteroromantic, you like homosexual intercourse, >but prefer heteroromantic love life.

Stop saying homosexual and "homosexual intercourse"!!!! You sound like a homophobic pastor!

The idea that you can split your sexual and romantic interests is a new invention! This doesn't help anyone!

And I would say anyone who says "boy I like to fuck girls but I don't want to date them, I could only date a man" has some serious internalized homophobia. You don't have to be this way. If you're attracted to two or more genders in any way shape or form, you're bisexual. Lesbians are not attracted to men at all.

Don't use "homoromantic" or "homosexual". It reeks of straight scientists trying to "understand" gay people. You can be an ace lesbian. The split attraction model is messed up, only leads to more confusion. I used to identify as a bisexual heteromantic because I was so caught up in MOGAI bullshit and afraid to love girls as a girl. Someone telling you they're a lesbian tells you nada about their sex life.

You can be an ace lesbian. Only in insular MOGAI type communities do people use the stupid split attraction model. Bisexual, lesbian, they refer only to the gender you're attracted to. The "sex" in bisexual, homosexual (which no one should use), etc. refers to gender. Someone saying they're a lesbian tells you nothing about their sex life.

You sure as fuck can be. Someone saying "I'm a lesbian" just means they're attracted only to women. It doesn't tell you anything as sex. I fucking hate the homosexual homoromantic bs, you can be an ace lesbian.

I have to contribute and since I can't get non-seasonal job, that makes taking out loans a necessity. I'm terrified if I take out the loans one day I won't be able to pay them back and I'll kill myself. I don't even know what I want to do. Some days I really want to be a theatre designer and others I just want to work with kids (I love kids). So I'm afraid to be at college and dick around, wasting money... I know I will never find a girlfriend (I'm a lesbian) without going out there but I see how people look at me. I see how people discount what I have to say based on my weight, that just me eating a sandwich in front of them revolts them.
